en: Black‑and‑white view of a European small town street, likely early 20th century. The scene shows a wide, mostly empty road bordered by multi‑story masonry buildings with steep tiled roofs and traditional façades. On the left is an inn with signage, beside older houses; on the right stands a larger, institutional‑looking building with arched windows and a gated entrance. Several telegraph poles with many insulators line the street. A horse‑drawn cart and a few pedestrians, including children standing in the foreground, occupy the road. Low hills or a wooded ridge appear in the distant background.
